implementation: State and lifecycle changes require exact matching history with a configured human approver, explicitly absent bot metadata, and verified inactivity on a complete fleet snapshot.

All integration events are unauthorized because current metadata has no trusted integration identity plus actual linked-PR merge correlation; generic integration type, GitHub naming and cached PR state confer no authority.
The human-label kill switch retains its activity exception but requires its own human-authored history entry; a lifecycle edit cannot substitute for missing kill-switch authorship.
History reads reject missing queried authorship/change fields and incomplete or repeated pagination cursors; failed later pages never yield partial authorizing evidence.
Existing unauthorized event attention and retained-worktree behavior are preserved; the runbook and completion/PR message explain manual human confirmation.

environment.isolation: Fake Linear/Orca/GitHub ports and temporary state; simulation git worktrees are isolated under temporary test roots.

commands.revision: original baseline source with initial regression tests
commands.result: 31 passed, 18 failed: reproduced integration Done, review resume, lifecycle overrides, missing human-label proof and partial-fleet authorization

commands.command: bun test tests/unit/machine/eventAuthorization.test.ts tests/unit/machine/reconcile.test.ts tests/unit/machine/classify.test.ts tests/unit/machine/answerDelivery.test.ts tests/unit/linear/client.test.ts tests/unit/linear/graphql.test.ts tests/unit/linear/templates.test.ts

coverage: Unrelated integration, GitHub-named integration, integration missing ID, application with approver actor, bot missing type, non-approver and missing actor controls for Done, review-to-InProgress, pause, unpause, lifecycle removal and human-label release.
Idle parked worktree retained across repeated unauthorized integration completion, including a cached MERGED PR; no worktree removal and only one terminal stop.
Human completion without PR/merge proof, human lifecycle pause/unpause, existing review resume and reply delivery, and human kill switch during agent activity.
Missing matching history, omitted queried fields, partial fleet, missing/repeated pagination cursors, later-page transport/GraphQL/shape failures and failed history read without state advancement.

limitations: No trusted integration allowlist or automatic completion path is added; even genuine GitHub integration closes require human confirmation until identity and actual linked merge correlation are implemented.
An integration close is surfaced as possible_self_close; a configured human approver must reopen and close again while no agent is active to confirm it.
No autonomous merge, cleanup behavior, Console behavior, production configuration/state, credentials, schedules, application pilots or old provider sessions were changed.
No live service validation, Linear/GitHub writes, pushes or PR operations were performed; the full repository test suite was not run.
